title: Add subtract(a, b) function and unit test
description: Implement a subtract(a, b) function in backend/app.py alongside the existing add(a, b) function, and write a unit test that verifies subtract(a, b) returns the correct difference for representative inputs.
acceptance_criteria: backend/app.py contains a subtract(a, b) function that returns a - b
The existing add(a, b) function remains unchanged and functional
A unit test exists that calls subtract(a, b) with sample inputs and asserts the expected result
All tests (existing and new) pass when run
